description:
When buying a health insurance policy, lots of factors need to be considered to get the right coverage within your budget. 

One important factor that can reduce your premium amount is the deductible. 

Deductibles are the amount paid towards your medical expenses before you can raise a claim.

In this video , we will explain that whether you should buy health insurance with deductible or not ?
